# Mookmati, The Silent Earth Studio

> Mookmati (mookmati.in) is an Indian brand selling handmade home textiles and crafts guided by ahimsa (non-violence), inspired by Acharya Shri Vidyasagar Ji Maharaj and his epic Mookmati. Products include handloom cotton, linen and Ajrakh sarees (no silk), jewellery, and hand block-printed 100% cotton bedsheets from Rajasthan priced from Rs 950 with free shipping across India. Orders are placed on WhatsApp (+91 94566 01984) or Instagram (@mookmatistudio). Store: GF193, Gaur City Center, Noida Extension (Greater Noida West), Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Products
- [Hand block-printed cotton bedsheets](https://mookmati.in/bedsheets.html): category overview, sizes, care and FAQs
- [Neelambari Navy and Mustard Bedsheet Set](https://mookmati.in/bedsheet-neelambari-navy-mustard.html): Neelambari: Rajasthani hand block-printed cotton bedsheet set with warm mustard motifs on deep navy and a classic striped border. Vegetable dyes, 100% cotton, king size 108 x 90 inches, with matching pillow covers. Free shipping across India. Rs 1,100
- [Cream Terracotta Border Bedsheet Set](https://mookmati.in/bedsheet-cream-terracotta-border.html): Rajasthani hand block-printed cotton bedsheet set with flower motifs on soft cream and a rich terracotta border. Natural vegetable dyes, 100% cotton, king size 108 x 108 inches, with matching pillow covers. Rs 950
- [Blue Coral Flower Bedsheet Set](https://mookmati.in/bedsheet-blue-coral-flower.html): Hand block-printed cotton bedsheet set with blue coral flowers and a borderless finish. Coloured with natural dyes, 100% pure cotton, king plus size 108 x 108 inches, with 2 matching pillow covers. Made in Rajasthan. Rs 1,500
